item.title: Gemini API File Search is now multimodal
item.description:
📝 5X 2X Today, we are expanding the Gemini API’s File Search tool. Give your apps a photographic memoryFile Search now processes images and text together. Show your work with page citationsWhen your application pulls an answer from a massive PDF, users need to verify exactly where that answer came from.

item.title: Sparse Cholesky Elimination Tree
item.description:
📝 Ultimately this tree tells us two things: 1. This is the column elimination tree. I proceeded directly from the right-looking Cholesky factorization to a task DAG, pruned that DAG, and then showed that the structural rule implied by step (3) of the algorithm results in a compressed representation of the task DAG, and that compressed representation happens to be a tree.
🔗 Read more: https://www.reidatcheson.com/sparse/linear/cholesky/2026/04/09/etree.html
